name: VIP (Etoposide / Ifosfamide / CISplatin, with mesna)
histology: germ cell tumor (serves BOTH seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT)

biomarkers.note: Bleomycin-free intensive regimen. Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) define IGCCCG risk. VIP is the bleomycin-sparing alternative for intermediate/poor-risk disease (e.g., pulmonary compromise) or viable germ cell tumor at surgery. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer, TEST-E.

lineOfTherapy: first-line combination chemotherapy for IGCCCG intermediate- or poor-risk germ cell tumor, or viable germ cell tumor at post-chemotherapy surgery; the bleomycin-free option when bleomycin is contraindicated

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: IGCCCG intermediate- or poor-risk disease, or viable germ cell tumor at surgery after first-line chemotherapy; bleomycin contraindicated or pulmonary risk
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, TEST-E VIP note (for intermediate/poor-risk disease or viable GCT at surgery [SEM-5 and NSEM-6]); footnote u (consider a bleomycin-free regimen)

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), VIP (Etoposide 75 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. Etoposide 75 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. NOTE a divergence: DeVita 12th ed. VIP (line 167562) specifies etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV daily x5; see evidence.divergence. Etoposide dose modeled at the guideline value (75 mg/m2).

drugs.name: ifosfamide

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), VIP (Ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 on Days 1 to 5 with mesna protection)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5 WITH MESNA PROTECTION (mandatory uroprotection against hemorrhagic cystitis). Monitor for ifosfamide encephalopathy. ISMP tall-man. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (line 167562 to 167564).

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), VIP (Cisplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. CISplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. ISMP tall-man. No lifetime cumulative cap; requires IV pre/post hydration; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, peripheral neuropathy. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (line 167564).

premedications.name: Mesna (uroprotection)
premedications.notes: Mandatory with ifosfamide to prevent hemorrhagic cystitis. DeVita 12th ed. VIP specifies mesna 400 mg/m2 IV every 8 hours on Days 1 to 5 (line 167563); confirm exact schedule against the institutional ifosfamide order set.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk)
premedications.notes: Multiday CISplatin plus ifosfamide; high-emetic-risk prophylaxis indicated.

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration with each CISplatin dose; adequate hydration also supports mesna uroprotection.

supportiveCare: G-CSF: VIP is high risk for febrile neutropenia; granulocyte colony-stimulating factor support should be used (NCCN TEST-E footnote 3).
Uroprotection: mesna with every ifosfamide dose; monitor urine for hematuria (hemorrhagic cystitis).
Neurologic: monitor for ifosfamide encephalopathy (confusion, somnolence).
Antiemetics: high emetic risk (multiday CISplatin plus ifosfamide). Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.
Nephroprotection: IV hydration and electrolyte repletion with each CISplatin dose.

monitoring: Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) before each cycle and at restaging
Renal function (creatinine/GFR) and electrolytes (Mg, K, Na) before each cycle - CISplatin
Ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy assessment - CISplatin
CBC before each cycle - high febrile-neutropenia risk

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ifosfamide and obtain clinical review; consider methylene blue per institutional protocol. Physician decides.
Increase hydration and mesna, hold ifosfamide, review. Physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: rising creatinine / falling GFR, ototoxicity, or grade 2+ neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Review required; consider dose reduction or delay. Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 167560 to 167564 (VIP four cycles q21d: etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV daily x5, ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 IV daily x5, cisplatin 20 mg/m2 IV daily x5, mesna 400 mg/m2 IV every 8 h x5)

guideline.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), VIP (Etoposide 75 mg/m2, Ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 with mesna, Cisplatin 20 mg/m2, Days 1 to 5, repeat every 21 days); footnote 3 (high febrile-neutropenia risk, use G-CSF); four cycles per SEM-4/NSEM-6

divergence.note: The two sources differ on the VIP etoposide dose: NCCN v2.2026 uses 75 mg/m2 while DeVita 12th ed. uses 100 mg/m2 (both over Days 1 to 5, q21d x4). The protocol models the guideline value (75 mg/m2). Selection left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for VIP (Etoposide / Ifosfamide / CISplatin, with mesna), the bleomycin-free intensive regimen for germ cell tumor. Serves BOTH histologies: seminoma (#60) and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT (#61), under testicular germ cell tumor (#59). Used for IGCCCG intermediate- or poor-risk disease, viable germ cell tumor at post-chemotherapy surgery, and when bleomycin is contraindicated (pulmonary risk). Doses from Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer v2.2026, TEST-E: Etoposide 75 mg/m2, ifosfamide 1200 mg/m2 (with mesna protection), CISplatin 20 mg/m2, all Days 1 to 5, repeat every 21 days for 4 cycles. A divergence is recorded: DeVita 12th ed. (line 167562) specifies etoposide 100 mg/m2 for VIP; the guideline value (75 mg/m2) is modeled and selection is left to clinical review. Ifosfamide mandates mesna uroprotection (hemorrhagic cystitis); DeVita states mesna 400 mg/m2 IV every 8 hours on Days 1 to 5 (line 167563). ifosfamide encephalopathy is monitored. VIP is high risk for febrile neutropenia so G-CSF should be used (NCCN TEST-E footnote 3). CISplatin has no lifetime cumulative cap; hydration and nephro/oto/neuro monitoring are specified. ISMP tall-man applied (CISplatin, ifosfamide). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
